sn3.14:1.4: “King Ajātasattu of Magadha, son of the princess of Videha, it seems, has mobilized an army of four divisions and marched against me to Kāsi.”
sn3.14:3.1: “Here, sir, King Ajātasattu of Magadha, son of the princess of Videha, mobilized an army of four divisions and marched to Kāsi to attack King Pasenadi of Kosala.
sn3.14:3.2: When King Pasenadi heard of this, sir:
sn3.14:3.3: ‘King Ajātasattu of Magadha, son of the princess of Videha, it seems, has mobilized an army of four divisions and marched against me to Kāsi.’
sn3.14:3.4: Then, sir, King Pasenadi of Kosala mobilized an army of four divisions and marched to Kāsi to defend it against King Ajātasattu of Magadha, son of the princess of Videha.
sn3.14:3.5: Then, sir, King Ajātasattu of Magadha, son of the princess of Videha, and King Pasenadi of Kosala met in battle.
sn3.14:3.6: And in that battle, sir, King Ajātasattu of Magadha, son of the princess of Videha, defeated King Pasenadi of Kosala.
sn3.14:3.7: And defeated, sir, King Pasenadi of Kosala withdrew to his own capital at Sāvatthī.”
